items.title: JPAR Founder JP Piccinini Aligns with Real to Help Agents and Brokerage Leaders Scale
items.summary: Entrepreneur brings two decades of experience building high-growth brokerages and agent-centric businesses The Real Brokerage Inc. (NASDAQ: REAX), a real estate technology platform focused on innovation and agent culture, today announced that entrepreneur and JPAR Real Estate founder JP Piccinini will be working with Real as a Growth Leader. In this role, he will work closely with Chief Growth Officer Jason Cassity to support agents, teams and brokerage leaders across the Real network. Over the course of his career, Piccinini has served as an agent, brokerage owner, franchisee and franchisor, giving him a broad perspective on the real estate industry at every stage of business development. Under this leadership, JPAR grew to approximately 4,000 agents across 22 states, generated more than $5 billion in annual sales volume and grew into one of the nation’s largest brokerages, earning a place among the Top 50 brokerages in the 2022 RealTrends 500 rankings based on 2021 performance.
